rec: Ectophial, or method of getting to Port Phasmatys

st.t: Talk to Jorral at the outpost south of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. You can teleport there with a Necklace of Passage.
s: Ok, I'll make a stand for history!

st.t: Talk to the Silver Merchant in the East Ardougne Market.

Go to Castle Wars and cross both bridges to the north. Stop about 4 steps north of the east side of the second bridge. When the enchanted key feels steaming, you're on the spot: dig there with a spade.
Use the enchanted key on the chest.
Talk to Blanin in south east Rellekka.
Talk to Dron in north Rellekka.
s: Why, you're the famous warrior Dron!
12, but what does that have to do with anything?

st.t: Enter Port Phasmatys and talk to Droalak outside the general store.
Give Melina a sapphire amulet in the house north east of the general store.
Return to Droalak outside the general store.
Return to Jorral north of West Ardougne with the scroll and journal.
Go up the stairs in East Ardougne castle, in the centre of the city just across the river, and talk to King Lathas on the 1st floor.
Return to Jorral north of West Ardougne with the letter to finish the quest.
